subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should the opt-in durable runtime, its shared SQLite schema, and its five Gateway RPCs be accepted on the 2026.7.1 release line, or should this stack be retargeted and staged on main after architecture review?
rationale: The PR creates new core runtime, storage, environment, protocol, and recovery policy surfaces; code review cannot determine whether that product and release commitment is intended.

options.title: Retarget and stage on main
options.body: Approve the direction provisionally, split or restack the work against current main, and require exact-head upgrade and recovery proof before landing each bounded layer.

options.title: Sponsor the release stack
options.body: Explicitly accept the new durable-runtime contract on the 2026.7.1 line after the dependency pin and complete exact-head proof are supplied.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Close or defer the cumulative stack until maintainers choose a smaller durable-runtime boundary and release plan.

recommendation.title: Retarget and stage on main
recommendation.body: Approve the direction provisionally, split or restack the work against current main, and require exact-head upgrade and recovery proof before landing each bounded layer.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate for the Gateway restart and recovery boundary and was explicitly surfaced in the prior review cycle.
